shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST QOSPolicy resources

options.name: attached_iam_roles
options.description: List of IAM Roles IDs which should be attached to that QOS Policy enabled

options.name: attached_users
options.description: The users to which to attach the policy, for a user QOS policy

options.name: capacity_limits
options.description:
Performance limits per unit of either used logical capacity or provisioned capacity, depending on the mode. Units
are stated per limit. Valid values: 0-4294967296. 0 means unlimited.

options.name: capacity_total_limits
options.description:
Performance limits per unit of either used logical capacity or provisioned capacity, depending on the mode. Units
are stated per limit. Valid values: 0-4294967296. 0 means unlimited.

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: is_default
options.description: Is default User QOS Policy

options.name: is_gold
options.description: Grants priority QoS over views that do not have this setting enabled.

options.name: limit_by
options.description:
Specifies which performance parameter(s) are limited by the policy. BW_IOPS=The policy limits service according
to bandwidth (BW) and IO per second (IOPS). BW=The policy limits service according to BW only. IOPS=The policy
limits service according to IOPS only.

options.name: mode
options.description: QoS provisioning mode

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: policy_type
options.description: QOS Policy type

options.name: s3_connections_limit
options.description: Maximum number of allowed S3 connections, 0 means unlimited

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: static_limits
options.description:
Performance limits per view. Maximum limits define maximum provisioning in the absence of resource contention.
Valid values: 0-4294967296. 0 means unlimited.

options.name: static_total_limits
options.description:
Performance limits per view. Maximum limits define maximum provisioning in the absence of resource contention.
Valid values: 0-4294967296. 0 means unlimited.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID

options.name: use_total_limits
options.description: If true - total limits are used instead of separate read/write limits.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
